newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cbank 3-day repo rate 12.42 pct (21.2pct).
newsitem.headline: Slovak cbank 3-day repo rate 12.42 pct (21.2pct).

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Friday said the average rate at its three-day securities repurchase tender fell to 12.42 percent, from 21.2 percent in the last similar tender last Friday.
The NBS added that it had allocated funds totalling 3.5 billion crowns, the full fixed amount it had offered in Friday's tender. It added bids totalled 5.51 billion crowns.
The maximum bid in the tender was 12.5 percent, while the minimum bid rate was 12.2 percent, the NBS added.
Last Friday, the NBS's three-day average repo rate rose to a record high of 21.2 percent as banks were squaring up for the minimum fortnightly reserve deadline on the following day.

According to official NBS figures, the banking sector is short of liquidity with banks' minimum reserve demands fulfilled at 95.23 percent as of Thursday, after being at 93.61 percent the previous day.
